+class _SocksProxyTransport(httpx.BaseTransport):
+    def __init__(self, proxy_url: str, verify_ssl: bool) -> None:

+        self._proxy_port = proxy.port or 1080

+    def handle_request(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
+        sock = socket.create_connection((self._proxy_host, self._proxy_port))
+        try:
+            self._negotiate_socks5(sock, request.url.host or '', request.url.port or 443)
+            stream = sock
+            if request.url.scheme == 'https':
+                context = ssl.create_default_context()
+                if not self._verify_ssl:

+                stream = context.wrap_socket(sock, server_hostname=request.url.host)
+
+            body = request.read()
+            self._send_http_request(stream, request, body)
+            status_code, headers, response_body = self._read_http_response(stream)
+            return httpx.Response(status_code, headers=headers, content=response_body, request=request)
+        finally:

+    def _negotiate_socks5(self, sock: socket.socket, host: str, port: int) -> None:
+        methods = [0x00]
+        if self._username is not None or self._password is not None:
+            methods = [0x00, 0x02]
+        sock.sendall(bytes([0x05, len(methods), *methods]))
+        version, method = self._read_exact(sock, 2)
+        if version != 0x05:
+            raise OSError('Invalid SOCKS5 proxy response')
+        if method == 0x02:
+            username = (self._username or '').encode('utf-8')
+            password = (self._password or '').encode('utf-8')
+            if len(username) > 255 or len(password) > 255:
+                raise OSError('SOCKS5 credentials are too long')
+            sock.sendall(bytes([0x01, len(username)]) + username + bytes([len(password)]) + password)
+            version, status = self._read_exact(sock, 2)
+            if version != 0x01 or status != 0x00:
+                raise OSError('SOCKS5 authentication failed')
+        elif method != 0x00:

+        version, status, _, atyp = self._read_exact(sock, 4)
+        if version != 0x05 or status != 0x00:
+            raise OSError('SOCKS5 connect failed')
+
+        if atyp == 0x01:
+            self._read_exact(sock, 4)
+        elif atyp == 0x03:
+            addr_len = self._read_exact(sock, 1)[0]
+            self._read_exact(sock, addr_len)
+        elif atyp == 0x04:
+            self._read_exact(sock, 16)
+        self._read_exact(sock, 2)
+
+    def _send_http_request(self, stream, request: httpx.Request, body: bytes) -> None:
+        path = request.url.path or '/'
+        if request.url.query:
+            path = f'{path}?{request.url.query.decode("ascii")}'
+
+        headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in request.headers.items()}
+        headers['host'] = request.url.host or ''
+        if request.url.port and request.url.port not in (80, 443):
+            headers['host'] = f'{headers["host"]}:{request.url.port}'
+        headers['connection'] = 'close'
+        headers['accept-encoding'] = 'identity'
+        headers['content-length'] = str(len(body))
+
+        request_line = f'{request.method} {path} HTTP/1.1\r\n'
+        header_lines = ''.join(f'{name}: {value}\r\n' for name, value in headers.items())
+        stream.sendall(request_line.encode('ascii') + header_lines.encode('latin-1') + b'\r\n' + body)
+
+    def _read_http_response(self, stream) -> tuple[int, dict[str, str], bytes]:
+        status_line = self._readline(stream).decode('latin-1').rstrip('\r\n')
+        _, status_code, _ = status_line.split(' ', 2)
+        headers = {}
+        while True:
+            line = self._readline(stream)
+            if line in (b'\r\n', b'\n', b''):
+                break
+            name, value = line.decode('latin-1').split(':', 1)
+            headers[name.strip()] = value.strip()
+
+        body = b''
+        transfer_encoding = headers.get('Transfer-Encoding', '').lower()
+        if 'chunked' in transfer_encoding:
+            chunks = []
+            while True:
+                chunk_size = int(self._readline(stream).split(b';', 1)[0].strip(), 16)
+                if chunk_size == 0:
+                    while True:
+                        trailer = self._readline(stream)
+                        if trailer in (b'\r\n', b'\n', b''):
+                            break
+                    break
+                chunks.append(self._read_exact(stream, chunk_size))
+                self._read_exact(stream, 2)
+            body = b''.join(chunks)
+        elif 'Content-Length' in headers:
+            body = self._read_exact(stream, int(headers['Content-Length']))
+        else:
+            chunks = []
+            while True:
+                data = stream.recv(65536)
+                if not data:
+                    break
+                chunks.append(data)
+            body = b''.join(chunks)
+
+        return int(status_code), headers, body
+
+    def _read_exact(self, stream, count: int) -> bytes:
+        data = bytearray()
+        while len(data) < count:
+            chunk = stream.recv(count - len(data))
+            if not chunk:
+                raise OSError('Unexpected end of stream')
+            data.extend(chunk)
+        return bytes(data)
